subject: infra.energy
name: National policy linking digital infrastructure to energy supply
what_would_settle_it: A national policy, strategy or programme document connecting power reliability or generation to digital-infrastructure planning.

subject: digital.rural
name: Dedicated rural digital-service programme
what_would_settle_it: A programme document or budget line for outer-island or rural digital-service delivery, distinct from the Starlink market entry.

subject: digital.localgov
name: Digitisation of district-administration systems
what_would_settle_it: A district-administration system specification or digitisation programme document.

subject: geopol.eu
name: European Union digital cooperation with Seychelles
what_would_settle_it: Any EU or European Investment Bank digital financing, programme or memorandum covering Seychelles.

subject: geopol.gulf
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Gulf-state digital investment in Seychelles
what_would_settle_it: Any Gulf-state investment, financing or memorandum covering Seychellois digital infrastructure.

subject: finance.budget
name: Domestic-state digital-transformation budget line
what_would_settle_it: A Seychelles government budget document or appropriation line for digital transformation.

subject: include.access
name: National accessibility framework
what_would_settle_it: A National Accessibility Action Plan, accessibility legislation, or an accessibility standard applying to government digital services — the government itself names all three as absent in May 2026.
disposition: absence stated by the government, not inferred

subject: include.access
name: Refugees, asylum seekers and internally displaced people
what_would_settle_it: Any record of refugees, asylum seekers, stateless persons or displaced people in Seychelles more recent than the 2021 UNHCR submission finding none.
disposition: dated finding that the population does not exist

subject: data.open
name: Open government data policy
what_would_settle_it: An adopted open-data policy or the closure of the 2020 extractives transparency corrective action that required one to be published.
disposition: absence cited to a dated corrective action
